(I)--adopted as daughter by the first king पृथु; mother of all creatures, of different janapadas, cities, castes, mountains, rivers, etc.;
1: M. १०. 1, ३५; वा. ४२. ७८-81; ५०. 2-4; ६

. ७४. ३०.
५० (१००(1/2) crores-म्। प्।) crores of yojanas in extent; its बाधविस्तार begins with योजनाग्र which is one crore in every direction from Meru in the middle; three crores of yojanas in all the four direc- tions; the inside circumference of the earth; the पर्यास equal to the extent of the नक्षत्र मण्डलम्;
2: Ib. १२४. १२; वा. ५०. ६८-75.
comprising seven islands and being tributary to the sons of स्वायम्- bhuva
--otherwise known as Lokapadma of which Meru forms the tendril; from this lotus came the four- faced ब्रह्मा; the earth, lotus shaped. वा. ३४. ३७, ४४; ४१. ८६.
